name: Kawazu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kawazu town emblem in white: a stylised device of curved strokes with a disc, like a bird's wing.
history: Municipal flag of Kawazu, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 1968.

features.role: Kawazu town emblem — a stylised device of curved strokes with a disc, like a bird's wing
